description: Builds, publishes, grows and maintains a B2B SaaS vendor's own Zapier integration - Platform CLI code (triggers, actions, auth, invoke and push), Zapier's review and beta, Partner Program tiers, publishing Zap templates, Workflow Element embeds and versioning without breaking live Zaps. Use whenever the user mentions their Zapier integration, zapier-platform CLI or Platform UI, the Zapier app directory, or a Zapier trigger that misses or duplicates records. Do NOT use for building Zaps as an end user, for calling existing Zapier apps from code or agents (Zapier SDK, Zapier MCP), for choosing embedded iPaaS (use samber/developer-platform-skills@connector-marketplace-strategy), or for generic marketplace listing work (use samber/developer-platform-skills@integration-listing-optimization).
